field_descriptions.active_ingredient: An active ingredient, typically chemical compounds and/or biologic substances.
field_descriptions.administration_route: A route by which this drug may be administered, e.g. 'oral'.
field_descriptions.alcohol_warning: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to consumption of alcohol while taking this drug.
field_descriptions.available_strength: An available dosage strength for the drug.
field_descriptions.breastfeeding_warning: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to this drug's use by breastfeeding mothers.
field_descriptions.clincal_pharmacology: Description of the absorption and elimination of drugs, including their concentration (pharmacokinetics, pK) and biological effects (pharmacodynamics, pD).
field_descriptions.clinical_pharmacology: Description of the absorption and elimination of drugs, including their concentration (pharmacokinetics, pK) and biological effects (pharmacodynamics, pD).
field_descriptions.dosage_form: A dosage form in which this drug/supplement is available, e.g. 'tablet', 'suspension', 'injection'.
field_descriptions.dose_schedule: A dosing schedule for the drug for a given population, either observed, recommended, or maximum dose based on the type used.
field_descriptions.drug_class: The class of drug this belongs to (e.g., statins).
field_descriptions.drug_unit: The unit in which the drug is measured, e.g. '5 mg tablet'.
field_descriptions.food_warning: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to consumption of specific foods while taking this drug.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.included_in_health_insurance_plan: The insurance plans that cover this drug.
field_descriptions.interacting_drug: Another drug that is known to interact with this drug in a way that impacts the effect of this drug or causes a risk to the patient. Note: disease interactions are typically captured as contraindications.
field_descriptions.is_available_generically: True if the drug is available in a generic form (regardless of name).
field_descriptions.is_proprietary: True if this item's name is a proprietary/brand name (vs. generic name).
field_descriptions.label_details: Link to the drug's label details.
field_descriptions.legal_status: The drug or supplement's legal status, including any controlled substance schedules that apply.
field_descriptions.maximum_intake: Recommended intake of this supplement for a given population as defined by a specific recommending authority.
field_descriptions.mechanism_of_action: The specific biochemical interaction through which this drug or supplement produces its pharmacological effect.
field_descriptions.non_proprietary_name: The generic name of this drug or supplement.
field_descriptions.overdosage: Any information related to overdose on a drug, including signs or symptoms, treatments, contact information for emergency response.
field_descriptions.pregnancy_warning: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to this drug's use during pregnancy.
field_descriptions.prescribing_info: Link to prescribing information for the drug.
field_descriptions.prescription_status: Indicates the status of drug prescription, e.g. local catalogs classifications or whether the drug is available by prescription or over-the-counter, etc.
field_descriptions.proprietary_name: Proprietary name given to the diet plan, typically by its originator or creator.
field_descriptions.related_drug: Any other drug related to this one, for example commonly-prescribed alternatives.
field_descriptions.rxcui: The RxCUI drug identifier from RXNORM.
field_descriptions.warning: Any FDA or other warnings about the drug (text or URL).
